description.en: Used by the skill scene script to read the fighting spirits set with CMND_SETUP_SKL_SQ_AVATAR: element 0 of the array receives the attacking side's spirit (ATK_AVATAR) and element 1 the defending side's (DEF_AVATAR).
Receives [atkSpirit, defSpirit]; create it with 2 elements.

true (the array is left unchanged if no skill setup exists).
null if the script system is not ready, no argument is given or it is not an array.

examples.case: In the skill scene script (real usage, from ie4_ev_sub_skl.nut)
